SteerCheckResponse.description:
X1: baseline vs steered (same seed) and the target feature's activation on each
finished text, re-encoded without steering. It reports whether the feature fires on the
resulting text; it does not say the output is better.

activation_change.description: (steered max - baseline max) / the feature's max_activation
activation_change.title: Activation Change

target_activation_baseline.description: max activation of the target feature over the new tokens of the baseline
target_activation_baseline.title: Target Activation Baseline

SteerCheckResponse.title: SteerCheckResponse

SteerCompareResponse.description:
X3: baseline and steered with the same seed, compared token by token. Indices are
0-based over newly generated tokens. In mock mode tokens are a word split.
SteerCompareResponse.title: SteerCompareResponse

SteerSweepResponse.description:

non-word runs and broken characters; it is not a quality score.

post.description:
X1. Baseline and steered with the same seed, plus the target feature's activation on
each finished text (re-encoded without steering). Not a quality score.
X3. Baseline and steered with the same seed, compared token by token.

X4. What the model writes from the prompt alone: no steering, same seed. Its text
equals the baseline_text of the steering calls with the same prompt, seed and length.

X2. Amplify at several strengths (default 0 to 2) with one seed; flags degenerate text.
One generation per strength plus the baseline, so this is the slowest call.
